header.name: PatrixWorld Sampler [TEXTUREAUDIT v0.2.6]
header.description: v0.2.6 TEXTUREAUDIT — adds 130 previously-unregistered textures covering snow_layer (observed as flat-white in v0.2.5 test), azalea + flowering_azalea, bamboo + bamboo_mosaic, dripleaf + pointed_dripstone, cave_vines + sculk set, cherry_sapling/trapdoor/door, copper 1.21 blocks (grate/trapdoor/chiseled/door), tuff set, crafter, deepslate_top, farmland wet/dry, frogspawn + 3 froglights, glow_lichen, hay_block, heavy_core, mangrove_roots + propagule, melon, moss_carpet, pink_petals, pitcher plant + crop, podzol, pumpkin_top/side/face_off, reinforced_deepslate, rooted_dirt, sniffer_egg variants, sugar_cane, suspicious_sand/gravel, torchflower family, trial_spawner + vault 1.21, warped/crimson nylium/roots/fungus, and all 12 small flowers (allium, poppy, tulips, cornflower, azure_bluet, etc.). All are proper 64x64 Patrix HD textures from the upstream reference pack — none are vanilla-resolution placeholders. Carries v0.2.5 DRIPBARK + all prior sampler content. Pair with BIGCANOPY v2.7.3 and PatrixWorld-Tectonic v0.2.0 SURVEY-FIX for full current stack.
